text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One morning, while walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo, thanks for the English textbook. You saved me.
Over नारे sleeping is definitely bad, I always end up forgetting stuff.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not at all, we help each other out!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"No, I definitely feel like I'm the one causing trouble.
I borrowed some just the other day, too."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I really need to pull myself together.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Next up is moving, right...
Phew... Well then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, right away~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Kya!?
Wait, Trainer! It's just you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, um... City-san, you
work as a model, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So apparently, she wasn't a morning person to begin with because of how busy she is, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like you've been especially tired lately.
I was just getting a little worried about you~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If only there was something I could do to help...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if it's work-related, it doesn't seem like there's anything I can help with.
If there's anything I can do—
choice_data_list: How about giving them a gift that'll cheer them up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A gift...!
I see, a gift, a gift...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Just the other day, I saw some clothes
that'll totally get you hyped up and looking great!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A dress that's perfect for dancing,
and a mature, smart-looking suit, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I could pull off either of them right now,
but since you're a model too, City-san, I'm sure
you'd look super cool in them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your passion...
but it wouldn't be good to spend too much.
Perhaps we should narrow it down to one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Only the dress?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!
Getting a bunch of gifts out of nowhere when it's not even your birthday
would definitely be startling. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I'll give it to them tomorrow right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the following day.
I happened to run into Sakura Chiyono O
just as she was handing over her present.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see. I made you worry, didn't I?
...Thanks. Can I open it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What came out of the paper bag was—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Bodycon?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! These are the clothes
a senior I really look up to told me about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect for dancing! Wearing this
gets me super hyped up~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Feeling super hyped...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! High spirits and totally groovy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahaha...! 
I see, thank you. ...I feel a lot better now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whew, what a relief~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I spotted Sakura Chiyono O
reporting how things turned out to the senior she looked up to—Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see, just the suit...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's true! Anyone would be surprised to suddenly get a bunch of gifts when it isn't even their birthday!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, in that case, I'll go out and buy it
today right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, that night.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Chiyo, I received the gift and the letter you hung on my doorknob.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you worry.
Thank you. So—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh, wh-... what?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, sorry, sorry.
It just felt so wonderfully 'Chiyo'.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's a jacket with shoulder pads, right? I'm so happy.
It cheered me right up. The matcha color is super cute too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I'm so glad! Right? My senpai told me
that matcha color is all the trend right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My senpai told me that suit is super hyped and totally rad, meant to be worn when it really counts!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, maybe I'll
wear it for my next interview or something.

The following month, Gold City appeared on TV
in a nostalgic suit with shoulder pads,
becoming a brief sensation.
